title: [review] COSE from_cbor lenient decoders leak IndexError/CBORDecodeError on non-map payloads (from_cose_sign1 path)
description: Pre-existing, surfaced during 2vp1 rounds: CapabilityPayload.from_cbor (capability_announcements.py), KeyRotationAttestationPayload.from_cbor, RootDioSignaturePayload.from_cbor, PrefixDelegationTokenPayload.from_cbor index the decoded object with no isinstance(dict) guard (unlike DelegationTokenPayload.from_cbor and local_facts' _loads_strict). On the from_cose_sign1 decode path, a non-map or truncated payload bstr escapes as IndexError / cbor2.CBORDecodeError instead of the documented ValueError. The 2vp1 __post_init__ check wraps this on the construction path, but from_cose_sign1's direct from_cbor call remains unguarded. Fix: add the dict guard + error normalization to the four lenient from_cbor decoders (mirror DelegationTokenPayload.from_cbor).
close_reason: Fixed (landed in a489f71e1c, swept into a worker3 sync commit by the driver before my own commit ran). isinstance-dict guard added to the 4 lenient from_cbor decoders (CapabilityPayload, KeyRotationAttestationPayload, RootDioSignaturePayload, PrefixDelegationTokenPayload), mirroring strict DelegationTokenPayload — non-map payloads now raise TypeError uniformly instead of shape-dependent IndexError/TypeError. 4 new tests (independent oracle), confirmed RED pre-fix via stash differential. 822/822 collectible crypto+capability+local-fact tests pass under uv venv. 3x reviewer-model codereview: correctness PASS, security PASS, edge PASS — zero findings.
